name: app/info-tip
title: InfoTip
summary: A small info button that explains the thing beside it; the explanation is a tooltip on hover and focus, and the button's accessible description.

props.name: about
props.description: What it explains; the button is named "About <about>".

props.name: id
props.description: The tooltip's id; unique per page.

behaviour: A focusable button with role="tooltip" text shown on hover and focus-visible.

keyboard: Tab focuses it, which shows the tip.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The tip is centred above the button, at most 16rem wide.
contract:
contract
  slot is "info-tip"
  button "About Members" min_height 20
end

checks.say: The button is named and described.

gaps: 32px on touch: meets WCAG 2.5.8 (24px), below the 44px the other app controls keep.
